highlights.excerpt:
Images, upgraded—introducing ChatGPT Images 2.6.

Now with GIFs and reference images.

Plus, two new models are coming to the API with 50% faster image generation.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
图像升级——推出 ChatGPT Images 2.6。

现已支持 GIF 与参考图。

此外，两款新模型即将登陆 API，图像生成速度提升约 50%。
highlights.name: OpenAI
highlights.text_zh: ChatGPT Images 2.6 上线：支持 GIF 与参考图；API 两款新图像模型生成提速约 50%。

highlights.excerpt:
Some news: I’m joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products!

I have a lot of respect for OpenAI for showing the world that scaling works, for bringing AI to over a billion people, and for believing great products are core to the mission.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
有个消息：我将加入 OpenAI，负责 Core Products 的产品管理！

我很尊重 OpenAI：向世界证明了 scaling 可行，把 AI 带给超过十亿人，并相信伟大的产品是使命的核心。
highlights.name: cat
highlights.text_zh: 原 Cursor 产品负责人 _catwu 官宣加入 OpenAI，负责 Core Products 产品管理。

highlights.excerpt:
Releasing the model weights of Kimi K3.1 Pro:
We'll keep advancing open intelligence.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的模型权重：
我们将继续推进开放智能。
highlights.name: Kimi.ai
highlights.text_zh: 月之暗面开源发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro 模型权重，继续推进开放智能。

highlights.excerpt:
Our security researchers built an autonomous cyber vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and patching pipeline.

In a single run with an upcoming cyber model, it validated and generated patches for 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel at a total API cost of $1.2 million.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们的安全研究人员构建了一套自主的网络漏洞发现、利用与修补流水线。

使用即将发布的网络模型单次运行，就在 Linux 内核中验证并生成了 948 个本地提权漏洞的补丁，API 总成本约 120 万美元。
highlights.name: OpenAI
highlights.text_zh: OpenAI 安全研究：即将发布的网络模型单次跑通发现并修补 948 个 Linux 内核提权漏洞，API 成本约 120 万美元。

highlights.excerpt: Underrated life advice: Have a Bad-Day Protocol. Go for a walk. Eat something clean. Hit a workout. Take a long shower. Get to bed early. Whatever. You don’t need to solve every problem when you’re at your worst. You need a few moves that stop a bad day from becoming a bad week.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 被低估的人生建议：准备一套「坏日子协议」。去散步。吃点干净的东西。做一次锻炼。好好洗个澡。早点睡觉。随便什么。你不必在状态最差时解决所有问题。你需要的是几招，阻止坏日子变成坏一周。
highlights.name: Sahil Bloom
highlights.text_zh: 被低估的建议：准备一套「坏日子协议」——散步、清淡饮食、锻炼、早睡，先阻止坏日变成坏周。

highlights.excerpt:
We’re sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life.

Vault particles are a longstanding mystery. They are barrel-shaped objects, among the largest protein structures found in our cells.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们分享生物研究团队如何与 Claude 合作，解析来自细菌生命的 vault 粒子首个 3D 结构。

Vault 粒子是长期未解之谜。它们呈桶状，是细胞中发现的最大蛋白结构之一。
highlights.name: Anthropic
highlights.text_zh: Anthropic 生物团队用 Claude 解析细菌 vault 粒子首个 3D 结构，攻克长期未解的蛋白组装谜题。

highlights.excerpt:
Today, we’re bringing GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and the API.

Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst, our two new API image models, generate images 50% faster than before.

At medium or high quality, Sunburst keeps details more consistent from one edit to the next.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
今天，我们将 GPT-Image-2.6 带到 Codex 与 API。

Image-2.6 Flare 与 Sunburst 两款新的 API 图像模型，生成速度比以前快约 50%。

在中等或高质量下，Sunburst 能在多次编辑间保持细节更一致。
highlights.name: OpenAI Developers
highlights.text_zh: GPT-Image-2.6 登陆 Codex 与 API；Flare/Sunburst 两款模型生成提速约 50%，编辑一致性更好。

你以为评论区都在纯看热闹吗？
